_comment: CELPIP Writing Task 2: Responding to Survey Questions. The user chooses Option A or B and explains why.

items.context: Your city has some extra money in its budget this year and is asking residents how to spend it.
items.question: Which project do you prefer?

options.text: Build a new public swimming pool.
Add more buses so that they come more often.

items.context: Your employer is thinking about changing the work schedule for all employees.
items.question: Which schedule do you prefer?

options.text: Work four ten-hour days each week.
Keep working five eight-hour days each week.

items.context: A local high school has a large empty room and is asking parents and neighbours how to use it.
items.question: What should the room become?

options.text: A computer lab with new equipment.
A quiet library and study space.

items.context: The management of your apartment building wants to add one shared facility for residents.
items.question: Which facility do you prefer?

options.text: A small gym in the basement.
A shared vegetable garden on the roof.

items.context: Your city is considering a change to its busiest downtown street.
items.question: Which plan do you support?

options.text: Close the street to cars on weekends so that people can walk and shop.
Keep the street open to cars and build a new parking garage.

items.context: Your company wants to thank its employees after a successful year.
items.question: Which reward do you prefer?

options.text: A one-time bonus of $1,000.
Three extra days of paid vacation.

items.context: Your community is planning one large event for next summer.
items.question: Which event should it organize?

options.text: An outdoor music festival with local bands.
A food fair with dishes from local restaurants.

items.context: The public library in your area can afford to open for more hours, but only at one end of the day.
items.question: Which change do you prefer?

options.text: Open two hours earlier in the morning.
Stay open two hours later in the evening.

items.context: The provincial government wants to add one required course for all high school students.
items.question: Which course should be required?

options.text: A course on personal finance and budgeting.
A course in a second language.

items.context: Your neighbourhood association is deciding what to build on an empty piece of land.
items.question: What should be built there?

options.text: A fenced park for dogs.
A playground for children.
